description:
Remaining after the 0.4.2 MuPDF sweep (bd-x0b / gh-111): (1) pdf-appearance.c synthesis for Highlight/Square/FreeText/Text icons etc. written without /AP (only Ink is synthesised); (2) page_to_stext runs /Contents only, MuPDF's stext includes annotations; (3) annotation /OC; (4) MuPDF refuses incremental saves on a REPAIRED document ('Can't do incremental writes on a repaired file') while write.rs still appends with /Prev pointing at the broken xref -- decide: refuse like MuPDF, or port a full rewrite. PdfDocument::was_repaired() exists since 0.4.2.

Mirrors GitHub gh-114 (https://github.com/theodoreOnzGit/kopitiam/issues/114).
title: kopitiam-pdf: annotations -- /AP synthesis beyond Ink, annotations in stext, saving repaired files
